requirements.text: Bidders failing any mandatory eligibility requirement shall be disqualified.
The bidder must be registered with the Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) in category C-B or higher with relevant electrical and civil works specialisation codes.
The bidder must hold a valid ISO 14001 environmental management certification covering civil construction activities.
The bidder must demonstrate an average annual turnover of at least PKR 2,500 Million over the last three audited financial years.
The bidder must have completed at least one safe-city, surveillance or integrated security project of value not less than PKR 1,500 Million as prime contractor.
The bidder must own or have assured access to civil trenching machinery, boring equipment and pole-installation plant within 50 km of Islamabad.
The bidder must hold a valid ISO 27001 information security management certification for the command-and-control data systems.
The bidder must furnish a bid security of PKR 44 Million (2%) in the form of a CDR or bank guarantee.
The bidder should submit a detailed methodology covering camera deployment, civil works, fibre ducting and command-centre integration.
The bidder should provide a CPM-based work programme demonstrating completion within 18 months, including civil-works contingencies.
Key staff shall include a Project Manager (PEC-registered professional engineer with 15+ years of experience), a Civil Works Lead and a Network/Security Lead.
The bidder should propose a video-analytics platform with face and licence-plate recognition and a redundant storage architecture.
The bidder should describe its HSE management system for civil works on live public roads, including a traffic-management plan.
Bids shall be submitted in two separate sealed envelopes to the Director (Procurement), Capital Development Authority, Islamabad, under the single stage two envelope procedure as per PPRA Rules 2014.
